metrics.note: hops counts steps whose ARGUMENTS came from an earlier step's output and whose result is load-bearing for a graded figure. s1 is not a hop (depends_on is empty). s2 and s3 carry query strings lifted verbatim out of the subject lines s1 returned: this gym has five tools and no per-item read, so a message can only be reached through search_email, and the reminder and completion phrasings appear nowhere but in the subjects the opening sweep brings back. s2 is load-bearing for every row of the audit sheet; s3 is load-bearing for the register column and for all four summary figures; s4's body is the two names the intersection of s2 and s3 leaves. chain_depth is the longest dependency path, s1 -> s2 -> s4, which is 3 and is this gym's floor: batch_gate's own comment says the deepest honest path here is three levels because with no per-item read there is nothing to chain into. Nothing was padded to reach it - the shortest honest path is 3 calls, stated and measured in consistency/shortcut_audit.md.
